# Webliix — Complete Knowledge Base & Service Specifications

> Webliix is a full-service digital agency and software engineering company registered as an MSME Enterprise in India (UDYAM-BR-07-0083560). Founded by Himanshu Sharma (Managing Director) and Abdul Latif (Technical Lead), Webliix engineers high-performance web platforms, custom web applications, Shopify e-commerce systems, mobile apps, and search engine optimization (SEO) solutions for clients across India, North America, Europe, and the Middle East.

## 2. Technology Stack & Architecture

Webliix builds with enterprise-grade, modern open technologies to guarantee longevity and speed:

### Frontend Engineering
- **Core Languages & Libraries**: React 19, JavaScript (ESNext), TypeScript
- **Styling & Motion**: Tailwind CSS v4, Modern CSS Custom Properties, GPU-accelerated CSS Keyframes, Framer Motion
- **Tooling & Build**: Vite, Rolldown engine, PostCSS, ESLint, Oxlint
- **Rendering & Optimizations**: Static Site Generation (SSG), Route-based dynamic code-splitting, `content-visibility: auto`, Responsive Cloudinary CDN image pipelines

### Backend & Cloud Infrastructure
- **Core Framework**: Java 21, Spring Boot 3.x
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL (Relational), Flyway Database Migrations
- **Security & Auth**: Spring Security 6, JWT Authentication, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
- **APIs**: RESTful JSON APIs, Swagger / OpenAPI 3.0 Documentation
- **Hosting & Deployments**: Cloudflare Pages / AWS / Render / Vercel Edge Networks

## 3. Services & Solution Breakdown

### 3.1 Custom Website Development
- **Target URL**: https://webliix.com/website-development
- **Overview**: Custom, responsive websites tailored for startups, small businesses, enterprises, and professionals.
- **Key Features**: 
  - Sub-second edge loading speeds
  - Responsive layout across mobile, tablet, and desktop
  - Custom React/Vite architecture with zero bloated CMS overhead
  - Lead-capturing contact forms with instant email and WhatsApp alerts
  - Full source code ownership transferred on project handover

### 3.2 Shopify E-Commerce Store Development
- **Target URL**: https://webliix.com/ecommerce-store
- **Overview**: High-converting Shopify and custom e-commerce storefronts built for scale.
- **Key Features**:
  - Bespoke Liquid theme design and modern headless setups
  - Payment gateway integrations (Razorpay, Stripe, Cashfree, PayPal)
  - Automated shipping rates and courier tracking integration
  - Conversion rate optimization (CRO) and streamlined checkout funnel
  - On-page product schema, meta tags, and inventory setup

### 3.3 Search Engine Optimization (SEO) & Google Business Profile (GMB)
- **Target URL**: https://webliix.com/seo
- **Overview**: Organic search optimization designed to build long-term traffic and local map domination.
- **Key Features**:
  - Google Business Profile (GMB) creation, verification, and category optimization
  - Local Map Pack (3-Pack) ranking strategy and citation building
  - Comprehensive technical SEO audits (Core Web Vitals, Crawlability, Sitemaps, Structured Data)
  - Keyword research, content strategy, and on-page metadata optimization
  - High-authority white-hat link building and press syndication

### 3.4 Custom Web Application & SaaS Development
- **Target URL**: https://webliix.com/web-app-development
- **Overview**: Full-stack bespoke software, customer portals, and SaaS platforms.
- **Key Features**:
  - Secure multi-tenant SaaS architecture
  - Custom internal tools (CRM, ERP, ticketing, invoicing, project management)
  - Microservices and modular RESTful API architecture
  - Robust role-based access control (Admin, Manager, Employee, Client)
  - Automated database backups, audit logging, and compliance tracking

### 3.5 Mobile Application Development
- **Target URL**: https://webliix.com/mobile-app-development
- **Overview**: Native and cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android.
- **Key Features**:
  - Single-codebase Flutter and React Native engineering
  - Offline-first capabilities and SQLite local caching
  - Push notifications, biometric authentication, and in-app purchases
  - App Store (Apple) and Google Play Store submission and compliance

### 3.6 Branding & UI/UX Design
- **Target URL**: https://webliix.com/branding-design
- **Overview**: Visual identities and product design that establish instant credibility.
- **Key Features**:
  - Custom vector logo creation with full copyright ownership
  - Complete brand guidelines (color theory, typography palettes, icon libraries)
  - High-fidelity interactive wireframes and prototypes in Figma
  - Design-to-code translation with reusable design systems

### 3.7 Website Maintenance & Developer Support
- **Target URL**: https://webliix.com/website-maintenance
- **Overview**: Proactive technical care keeping digital assets fast, secure, and operational.
- **Key Features**:
  - 24/7 uptime monitoring and incident response
  - Weekly security audits, dependency updates, and SSL renewal management
  - Automated offsite cloud backups
  - Dedicated developer hours for feature requests, bug fixes, and content updates

### 3.8 Performance Marketing & Paid Advertising
- **Target URL**: https://webliix.com/paid-advertising
- **Sub-pages**: 
  - Google Ads: https://webliix.com/google-ads
  - Meta Ads: https://webliix.com/meta-ads
- **Overview**: Transparent, data-driven paid advertising delivering qualified inbound leads.
- **Key Features**:
  - Google Search Ads with strict negative-keyword lists to prevent wasted spend
  - Google Local Services Ads (LSA) and Performance Max campaigns
  - Meta (Facebook & Instagram) lookalike audience and retargeting funnels
  - Conversion pixel setup with server-side Conversion API (CAPI)

## 4. Package Pricing & Investment Models

### Webliix LaunchKit (Turnkey 5-Day Business Package)
- **URL**: https://webliix.com/launch-kit
- **Starter Package**: ₹9,999 (~$149 USD) one-time investment.
  - 5 Custom responsive pages
  - Modern React & Tailwind frontend
  - Vector brand logo design
  - Google Business Profile setup & local SEO foundation
  - 1-Year domain configuration & HTTPS SSL
  - Contact enquiry forms with WhatsApp integration
  - 30 Days post-launch warranty support
- **Growth Package**: ₹18,999 (~$279 USD) one-time investment.
  - Up to 10 Custom pages with blog / case study publishing engine
  - Advanced on-page SEO & Schema.org JSON-LD
  - Social media integration & Google Analytics 4 tracking
  - Priority delivery in 7–10 days

### Custom Development & Retainer Engagements
- **Custom Web Applications / SaaS**: Milestone-based scoping following discovery.
- **Shopify Stores**: Custom packages starting from ₹14,999 (~$199 USD).
- **SEO & Google Ads Retainers**: Monthly management packages with zero lock-in contracts.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Who owns the website and source code?
The client receives 100% full ownership of the source code, design assets, and database upon project completion. Webliix does not practice vendor lock-in or proprietary licensing fees.

### What is the typical delivery timeframe?
- **Webliix LaunchKit**: 5 to 7 business days.
- **Standard Business Websites**: 7 to 14 business days.
- **Shopify Stores**: 10 to 18 business days.
- **Custom SaaS / Web Applications**: 4 to 8 weeks in phased sprint milestones.

### How does Webliix handle SEO?
Webliix builds websites with technical SEO foundations: semantic HTML5, valid Schema.org JSON-LD structured data, responsive viewports, Open Graph social tags, XML sitemaps, non-blocking fonts, and sub-second Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) performance.

### How can a business get started?
Clients can request a consultation via https://webliix.com/contact or reach the engineering team directly at contact@webliix.com or +91 93101 81569.
